mapper.sql: id, question_id, code_runner_config_id, attempt_id, student_id, source_code, idempotency_key, submission_mode, status, verdict, score, max_score, worker_id, lease_until, accepted_at, created_at, completed_at, attempt_count, next_attempt_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edu.code_submissions WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT 1 FROM edu.attempts WHERE id = #{attemptId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.code_submissions (id, question_id, code_runner_config_id, attempt_id, student_id, source_code, idempotency_key, submission_mode, status, verdict, score, max_score, accepted_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{questionId},#{configId},#{attemptId},#{studentId},#{sourceCode},#{idempotencyKey}, #{mode, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler},#{verdict},#{score},#{maxScore},#{acceptedAt},NOW())
mapper.select: UPDATE edu.code_submissions SET status = 'PROCESSING', worker_id = gen_random_uuid(), lease_until = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes' WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM edu.code_submissions WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW())) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < NOW()) ORDER BY accepted_at ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) RETURNING *;
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.code_submissions SET status=#{status}, verdict=#{verdict}, score=#{score}, completed_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{submissionId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE edu.code_submissions SET status=#{status}, attempt_count=#{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt} WHERE id=#{submissionId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.code_submission_test_results (id, submission_id, test_case_id, execution_status, verdict, points_earned, time_ms, memory_kb, diagnostic, received_output, engine_submission_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{submissionId},#{testCaseId},#{executionStatus},#{verdict},#{pointsEarned}, #{timeMs},#{memoryKb},#{diagnostic},#{receivedOutput},#{engineSubmissionId},NOW()) ON CONFLICT (submission_id, test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET execution_status=EXCLUDED.execution_status, verdict=EXCLUDED.verdict, points_earned=EXCLUDED.points_earned, time_ms=EXCLUDED.time_ms, memory_kb=EXCLUDED.memory_kb, diagnostic=EXCLUDED.diagnostic, received_output=EXCLUDED.received_output, engine_submission_id=EXCLUDED.engine_submission_id, created_at=NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id,r.submission_id,r.test_case_id,t.external_test_id,t.visibility,r.execution_status,
r.verdict,r.points_earned,r.time_ms,r.memory_kb,r.diagnostic,r.received_output,r.engine_submission_id FROM edu.code_submission_test_results r JOIN edu.code_runner_test_cases t ON t.id=r.test_case_id WHERE r.submission_id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY t.ordinal
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu.code_submissions WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'CLAIMED')

SELECT (score / max_score) FROM edu.code_submissions WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND submission_mode = 'SUBMIT' AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND max_score > 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM edu.code_submissions WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND submission_mode = 'SUBMIT' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM edu.code_submissions WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND submission_mode = 'SUBMIT' AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
